generalization_risks: host_backward now discards nonzero cotangent residuals when _collinear_coefficient accepts approximate collinearity. A residual below 8*eps times the largest cotangent entry can still dominate after multiplication by an ill-conditioned inverse transpose. For example, direction=(1,0), cotangent=(1,1e-16), and A=diag(1,1e-20) pass the predicate but replace the correct adjoint (1,1e4) with (1,0). The approximate Hermitian shortcut likewise omits A^-1(N^H-N)w without bounding its amplification. Neither shortcut checks the resulting solve residual or conditioning. These new gradient risks apply to both large and aLIGO configurations outside the tested inputs; retain the explicit solves unless equivalence or an adequate error bound is established.
